raw_scene_note: Creator supplied a zodiac/polarity carousel text spine and identity references, not a literal lived incident. This run treats the copy as a draft spine and repairs it into staged Aachu/Zuv behavior before copy lock.

success_definition.audience_success: A cold viewer in a Capricorn/Aries or planner/impulse couple sends it with 'this is us' because both partners feel recognized, not mocked.
success_definition.creative_success: The carousel works as a sequence of staged decisions: he builds structure, she creates motion, conflict turns into tenderness, and every slide has visible action before text.
success_definition.brand_success: The zodiac doorway becomes Aachu/Zuv-specific warm desi relationship IP: calm planning, expressive starting, screenshots, instinct, silent worry, loud fighting, and chosen chaos.
success_definition.production_success: If approved, this must advance into copy lock, post-copy visual room, visual debate, selected actual identity bundle, proof slide, native 4:5 finals, separate native 9:16 finals, visual QA, and final audit.
success_definition.story_theme_success: Protect the machine: two different operating systems are not incompatibility; they become a relationship engine because his stability gives her spark a runway and her spark makes his plans become life.

selected_concept_process_card.name: Banter To Belonging
selected_concept_process_card.reason: The supplied copy is a playful contrast deck. It passes only if the contrast moves from joke to belonging and never makes Aachu a problem or Zuv passive.

memory_exclusions_and_repairs: Avoid repeating the generic chaos/home lane; use 'different operating systems' and staged behavior instead.
Avoid ordinary plan-turned-date/errand romance rejected as cheesy; make planning versus starting a visible action engine.
Avoid perfect-husband/enabler drift; Zuv must act, worry, prepare, choose, and eventually join.
Avoid quote-card zodiac meme execution; astrology is only the public doorway, not the visual system.
